messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: Getting error while loading rhdfs in R
parts:
I see this error message in your log

Environment variable HADOOP_CMD must be set before loading package rhdfs

It seems like the environments on the nodes is not properly set for the package to load. Additionally, please remember that the main input for a job has to be the input to the mapreduce call, not a file that you open in the mapper. Of course unless performance is irrelevant.


Antonio

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#305] Re: Getting error while loading rhdfs in R
parts:
Hi
that's because the environment in which rmr runs is not your local environment (we are using a cluster after all). To test your node environment as seen by rmr you can do this

detach("package:rhdfs")
values(from.dfs(mapreduce(to.dfs(1), map = function(k,v) Sys.getenv())))

The output can be long, be prepared to scroll around, or test only specific variables that you are interested in. I still think you shouldn't need rhdfs in a mapper and should just detach it before calling mapreduce and be done with it. I think I'd clarify that before spending any more time on configuring rhdfs on the nodes.


Antonio
